title: SHARP: Unlocking Interactive Hallucination via Stance Transfer in Role-Playing LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces the SHARP benchmark to evaluate 'interactive hallucination' in role-playing LLMs, focusing on how character relationships influence a model's stance on factual vs. counterfactual claims (sycophancy vs. adversarial behavior). It does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the study.
